name: correlational-parameter recurrent map
historical_source: Watson et al. 2014 (S1), Eq. 1 plus the Hebbian selection result

mathematical_definition.inner: x(t+1) = x(t) + tau1*sigma(W x(t)) - tau2*x(t); x(0)=g; sigma=tanh; tau1=1; tau2=0.2
mathematical_definition.outer: delta w_ij = r * s_i * s_j, r>0, conditional on sign-agreement between phenotype and selection direction

causal_computational_function: accumulates pairwise correlations of externally selected states into the parameters of the map that generates future states
required_substrate: a slow parameter channel separate from the fast state
an external selection filter supplying s
current_state_effect: x* is drawn toward stored correlation structure
future_distribution_effect: the distribution of x* reachable by perturbing g is reshaped by W -- DEMONSTRATED IN THE EQUATIONS, NOT MEASURED
acquisition_effect: fewer mutations to reach targets sharing the stored regularity (S1, S3); UNMEASURED for orthogonal targets
known_limitations: Hebbian equivalence exact only at T=1 with sigma=identity; approximate in the recurrent nonlinear regime where the interesting behaviour lives
no symmetry constraint on W recovered, so associative-memory guarantees are not licensed
unnormalised storage predicts spurious attractors and capacity saturation (DERIVED, unmeasured)
generalisation is bounded to the trained family: strongest demonstrated level G3
recursion depth ONE -- nothing selects over the update rule

cross_system_analogues.status: FORMAL for the update rule, ANALOGICAL_ONLY for the attractor/storage guarantees

evidence_strength: SIMULATED + partially FORMAL. Not causally isolated: no same-probe counterfactual exists in any recovered source.

name: regularisation pressure on stored structure

mathematical_definition.form: a cost term on W favouring small (L2) or few (L1) nonzero entries, added to the selective objective
mathematical_definition.biological_reading: reproduction and maintenance cost of gene-regulatory connections

causal_computational_function: controls the memory/lock-in balance by penalising stored structure, converting memorisation into generalisation
current_state_effect: sparser or smaller W; typically lower fit to any single historical target
future_distribution_effect: broader, more transferable phenotype distribution -- the explicit evolvability claim of S3
acquisition_effect: improved adaptation in previously-unseen environments of the SAME structural regularity
known_limitations: transfer demonstrated only within a regularity; orthogonal regularity untested
evolvability is DEFINED as generalisation in S3, so the link is definitional rather than discovered

name: selection-noise as a generalisation control

mathematical_definition.form: stochastic perturbation of the selective target s across generations

causal_computational_function: prevents W from over-fitting any single historical target set
current_state_effect: lower fit to any individual target
future_distribution_effect: phenotype distribution reflects the regularity rather than the instances
known_limitations: a control, not a mechanism -- it modulates P-EAL-001 and does nothing alone
no dose-response characterised in the recovered text
